# XION Potato Flakes — potatoesflakes.com

> Potato flakes, potato flour and frozen potato products from a Chinese manufacturer, sold B2B in bulk. Product pages carry specifications, packaging options and application notes for food processors, distributors and private label buyers.

## Products
- [All Products](https://potatoesflakes.com/product/): Potato flakes, potato flour, frozen fries and related potato products.
- [Black Spot Potato Flakes](https://potatoesflakes.com/product/2025-super-cheap-black-spot-potato-flakes/): Economy grade for further processing.
- [Potato Flakes for Fish Bait and Animal Feed](https://potatoesflakes.com/product/potato-flakes-for-fish-bait-and-animal-feed/): Non-food grade applications.
- [Frozen French Fries — Crinkle Cut 2kg](https://potatoesflakes.com/product/french-fries-crinkle-cut-2kg-bag/): Retail-ready frozen fries.
- [Frozen French Fries 3–8mm](https://potatoesflakes.com/product/3-8-frozen-french-fries-zhongda-meicheng/): Food-service cut size.
